claim: Sparse canonical construction after sorting, independent of modulus magnitude; a specialization of established envelope machinery, not a new generic transform algorithm
definition: Sort distinct residues r_i, let w_i=r_i+nu_i. Keep i iff w_i>max_{j<i}w_j and w_i+g>max_{j>i}w_j, with empty maximum minus infinity. Prefix/suffix scans take O(t) arithmetic/comparisons after sorting, O(t log t) overall and O(t) storage. Bit complexity is separate.
tests: All nonempty profiles g=1..4, with each residue absent or span in 0..2g+1 (15420); compare a separately implemented pairwise criterion and all phases. Seed20261022, g=2^61-1, t=1,2,3,8,32,128,512, 16 random span profiles each: compare pairwise and every reset boundary. Large t=1024,4096,16384 uniform-span/all-survivor and one-dominator families: verify known complete canonical outputs and selected envelope values. Preserve uncompressed outcomes and count all cases.
interpretation: Exact representation/construction complexity only. No measured runtime/bytes, native receiver, policy or hardware benefit claim. No timing inputs or previous results are changed.
